description: F7 rule 10 golden: B6 markout decomposition (iap.tca.markout_decomposition; API_TRADING.md section 2.16). cluster_mean cases; `day_clusters` = fill_rows / decompose / markout_decomposition over the fixed fills ([fill_id, order_id, parent_id, instrument_id, venue_id, side, price_ticks, qty, ts, liquidity, fee, impact_cost]) and orders (B4/B5/B2 provenance fields) on the fixed timeline of expected_f7_fading.json, tick 0.01, qty_unit 1, day_ns 100 s; `one_cluster` = the same at qty_unit 100 with cluster 's' and day_ns one day. The SciPy-derived Student-t fields (p_student_t, ci95) live under expected_tol (same tree shape, compared to tolerance); everything else byte for byte.
parity: canonical JSON bytes of `expected` (sorted keys, no whitespace, Python float repr) must equal the C++ port's canonical bytes; `expected_tol` (when present) is compared to `tolerance`

slice.rule: fill_rows / decompose / markout_decomposition over the planted fills with clusters of 30 s (day_ns)
slice.timeline_rule: after every event with a two-sided consolidated book: append_state_pinned(ts, best_bid_ticks * tick, best_ask_ticks * tick, bid_sz, ask_sz) (crossed states skipped; no halts)

cluster_mean.error: values and clusters must have the same length

markout_decomposition.inference: equal-weight mean per fill, CR1 SE clustered by day, Student-t G-1 df
